overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Technology ETF (TTEQ) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on information technology equity. TTEQ is actively managed, seeking long-term capital growth by investing in large-cap technology companies globally and those whose market share is largely based on their technology capabilities. TTEQ was launched on Oct 23, 2024 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
